caption: Basilica, Hulst
composition: Crossing tower with the 1957 concrete crown · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Sint-Willibrordusbasiliek stands in the fortified centre of Hulst, Brabant Gothic brick with the tower rising from the crossing. The crown is the angular concrete spire of 1957, with a plain cross, not a medieval needle. The sky is clear, about 15.1°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h, and a bright moon is up. The church is closed.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Hulst basilica at night, Gothic brick and a modern concrete spire under a clear sky
